extra.final_summary: Total body mass by species (grams): Adelie = 77,000 g (21 penguins), Chinstrap = 53,225 g (15 penguins), Gentoo = 77,600 g (14 penguins after exclusions). Data problems found: 3 rows (22, 28, 49) had impossible body_mass_g values (5,050,000 / 5,050,000 / 4,050,000 g), far outside the rules-file range of 2500–6500 g; these were excluded with approval. Species labels were clean (no variants/misspellings), no duplicate rows, and body_mass_g was otherwise fully numeric with no negatives. Caveats: flipper_length_mm has 3 negative values and sex has 2 missing/whitespace variants, but neither column affects this question, so they were left untouched. Totals are based on 50 of 53 rows.
